items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: I can't say that -- I really can't say that I was really influenced by her. However, I certainly have great respect and admiration for her

ctx.x: So you were arranging for a 17-piece band.

Yes, I -- I thought that was what I wanted to do. You know, I enjoyed doing it at that time. I really never gave any thought to ever really becoming a vocalist. At that time I did maybe -- I would do a couple of songs, something -- you know, I think most people have one or two songs that they particularly like. I would maybe do a couple of songs like that, but I didn't really concentrate on being a singer. But I did concentrate on being an arranger, because I loved chords and I had a good sense of chords, you…
into arranging, and this is really her forte. She was an excellent arranger, and I don't know at that time -- maybe I was sort of inspired by her and didn't realize it.
